explanation: People who perform practical work for the community's needs, here specifically the seven men chosen to oversee food distribution.
Allocated or distributed resources (food) fairly among all in the congregation without discrimination.
Something set apart for God's use, here referring to the seven men who were full of the Spirit and wisdom.
Deep insight and the ability to make sound decisions in difficult situations, a quality of the chosen servants.
Describes an inner abundance of the Holy Spirit that gave strength and guidance to the apostles and the seven men.
People directly sent by Jesus to spread the gospel, here responsible for prayer and the ministry of the word while others handled practical tasks.
Greek-speaking Jews living outside Palestine, whose widows were accused of being overlooked in food distribution.
Hebrew-speaking Jews from Judea and Galilee, the dominant group in the church at this time.
Describes how the Holy Spirit filled the seven men so that their service became effective and divinely guided.
